recipes.name: Croque Madame: The Ultimate Breakfast Sandwich
ingredients: Butter for toasting bread and cooking eggs
instructions: For the Béchamel Sauce - 2 tbsp butter - 2 tbsp flour - 1 ¼ cups milk
In a medium saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. - 2 tbsp butter
Add the flour and whisk continuously until the mixture turns golden brown and smells slightly nutty. This is your roux. - 2 tbsp flour
Gradually add the milk, whisking constantly to avoid lumps, until the sauce thickens into a smooth, creamy béchamel. - 1 ¼ cups milk

Season the sauce with kosher salt, freshly ground black pepper, and a pinch of freshly grated nutmeg. Set aside while you prepare the rest of the sandwich. - Salt and pepper to taste - Freshly ground nutmeg to taste

Take rustic bread slices and brush with melted butter. In a pan with melted butter, brown the bread and pile high with ham. You should end up with two golden brown plain ham sandwiches. Place the sandwiches on a broiler pan. - 4 slices thin of rustic bread - 1 tbsp melted butter - Sliced ham - Butter for toasting bread and cooking eggs
Open the sandwiches back up and place the gruyere cheese on each sandwich. Place the slice back on top of the sandwich. Top each sandwich with the bechamel sauce. - ½ cup shredded gruyere cheese
Place the broiler pan with sandwiches into broiler. Leave to cook for about 2-3 minutes or until the bechamel sauce is browned and bubbly.

While the sandwiches are cooking, melt butter in a pan. Crack eggs and cook with cover. Whites should be set and the yolks should be runny. Season with salt and pepper. - 2 eggs - Butter for toasting bread and cooking eggs
Take the sandwiches off of the broiler pan and plate. Place a fried egg on top of each one. Then, eat.
